GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.4 (28 Jun 46) CS
(SCAPIN-1041)
APO 500
28 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Relief for the Japanese Nationals in Manchuria.
1. References:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, AG 091.4 (22 Feb 46)CS, (SCAPIN - 761), 22 February 1946, Subject: "Relief for Japanese Nationals in Manchuria".
b, CLO memorandum No 194 (5.2), subject: "Relief for the Japanese Nationals in Manchuria".
2. Information has been received from the Chinese Government to the effect that 100,000,000 Manchurian yuan have been turned over to the Association of Japanese Nationals in Manchuria. In addition to this, the Chinese state that they intend to turn over another 4,000,000 to the Association as administrative expenses.
3. The manner of reimbursement will be decided at some later date.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
